digest.component_or_area: LLM runner and structured request building
propositions: Fourteen call sites across src/rebar/llm hand-build identical single-turn structured request patterns with embedded bounds, creating maintenance risk and invisible policy omissions
RunRequest's contract requires mode='structured' and execution_mode='single_turn' to stay consistent, but nothing enforces this invariant at construction time
Bounds decisions are invisible in thirteen of fourteen sites because lowering-only seams have no defaults, making omission indistinguishable from deliberate unboundedness
A shared builder RunRequest.for_structured(..., bounds=...) with required bounds argument makes the bounding decision explicit and enforceable
AST guard test must be updated to recognize both RunRequest(...) and RunRequest.for_structured(...) patterns as valid structured constructions
